dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Sporadic cortical cerebellar degeneration (likely paraneoplastic) with accompanying cortical myoclonus

Alternatives:
1. Wilson disease (occult presentations can present atypically in older adults)
2. Gluten ataxia associated with celiac disease
3. Adult-onset Unverricht-Lundborg disease / progressive myoclonic epilepsy
